# keyword_identifier

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Avoids SQL keywords as identifiers.

**Default level:** `warn`

**Fixable:** no

## Rationale

Keyword-shaped identifiers are valid in some contexts but remain confusing to readers.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
keyword_identifier = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
SELECT a AS "select" FROM foo
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
SELECT a AS selected_value FROM foo
```
